versions.changelog:
ClawdGo 1.3.2 brings persistent profile/memory architecture, a richer command set, and training flow upgrades:

- Introduced three-layer memory system with persistent profile in `runtime/clawdgo-profile.json`, soul.md anchors, and self-generated scenarios folder.
- First-run now auto-initializes with 47 training records from seed profile if no profile exists.
- Expanded trigger words and richer mode/command routing, including new workshop, vaccine, and B-mode explicit/后台/观摩 triggers.
- Main menu, command card, and mode descriptions updated for new context ("场景工坊", "安全疫苗", "H 联网斗虾" as internal beta).
- New event sync: session/profile changes now written to JSON on mode/session updates.
- Removed dependency on legacy soul.md for runtime, aligning with new bootstrapping and profile sync logic.

ClawdGo v1.2.0 Changelog

- Removed internal reference files: evolve-prompt.md, scoring-rubric.md, training-scenarios.md.
- The skill no longer depends on these scenario-building and rubric documents.
- No user-facing functional change. All previously supported training and evaluation modes remain available.

v1.1.0 (2026-03-18)
New Training Modes

B Self-Training — Lobster autonomously plays attacker, defender & judge; no human needed
C Random Exam — 5 cross-layer random questions, timed
D Teaching Mode — Lobster quizzes the owner
E Evolve Mode — Auto-generates new scenarios from DongSec Talk articles
F Arena — Red vs. Blue 5-round adversarial, dual-instance support
G Security Chant — Eight-word mnemonic written to soul.md as permanent security foundation
New Capabilities

20 scenarios across 3 layers, 12 dimensions (up from 5)
Four-dimension scoring + rank system (S/A/B/C/D)
Cross-session memory via soul.md
Cron scheduled training support
Full command mapping with A-G shortcuts
Community scenario PR contribution system

Initial public release of ClawdGo v1.0.0.Teach lobster agents how to fish for themselves: learn security judgment independently, continuously improve security awareness, and build a hard shell in a digital ocean full of temptation and traps.
